lede: MTM Group at Toh Guan Enterprise Hub is a car workshop. Its own website calls it a one-stop car workshop, with servicing packages, repairs and maintenance, accident claims, spray painting, modifications and car sales.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention a smooth, no-pressure car buying process with clear paperwork, and careful measurement and neat workmanship on a big brake kit installation.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, mtm.sg.
good_to_know: Its website mentions an MTM Warranty on repair and maintenance work
Also sells new and used cars, according to its website
